title: Egyptian Citrus Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew from Egypt, made with tender beef and a burst of citrus.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove beef and add onion; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add broth, citrus juice, and spice blend; stir to combine.
Return beef to pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
